---
title: "Config Provider"
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
source(file.path("..", "..", "shots.R"))
```

Config Provider is used for providing global configurations, which enables your entire application to access these configurations everywhere.

## i18n Configurations

Configure i18n related properties via Config Provider, to get language switching feature.

Use two attributes to provide i18n related config

The button switches the language of what is inside the provider, with
`update_el_config_provider(locale =)`: the table's empty text, the
pagination's words. The page's own language is `el_page(locale =)`.

```{r usage, eval = FALSE, shot = TRUE, shot_js = c("window.zh = document.querySelector('#cfg .el-pagination').innerText.indexOf('\\u5171') >= 0", "document.querySelector('#toggle button').click()"), shot_expect = c("window.zh", "document.querySelector('#cfg .el-pagination').innerText.indexOf('Total') >= 0")}
ui <- el_page(
  el_button("toggle", "Switch Language"),
  tags$br(),
  el_config_provider(
    id = "cfg",
    locale = "zh-cn",
    el_table(data = data.frame(date = character(), name = character())),
    el_pagination("cfg_pg", total = 100, layout = "total, prev, pager, next")
  )
)
server <- function(input, output, session) {
  language <- reactiveVal("zh-cn")
  observeEvent(input$toggle, {
    language(if (language() == "zh-cn") "en" else "zh-cn")
    update_el_config_provider(session, "cfg", locale = language())
  })
}
shinyApp(ui, server)
```

## Button Configurations

The checkboxes and the select are a store's fields, [vue_bind()]; the
provider's `button` settings are a getter of the store built from them,
which the button inside takes as its defaults -- all in the browser.

```{r button, eval = FALSE, shot = TRUE, shot_js = c("document.querySelector('#cfg_dashed .el-checkbox').click()", "document.querySelector('#cfg_plain .el-checkbox').click()"), shot_expect = c("document.querySelector('#cfg .el-button.is-dashed')", "!document.querySelector('#cfg .el-button.is-plain')")}
vue_store(
  "cfg_button",
  state = list(
    autoInsertSpace = TRUE,
    type = "default",
    plain = TRUE,
    round = TRUE,
    text = FALSE,
    dashed = FALSE
  ),
  getters = list(config = JS("function(s) { return Object.assign({}, s); }"))
)
tags$div(
  el_checkbox(
    "cfg_space",
    "autoInsertSpace",
    value = vue_bind("$store.cfg_button.autoInsertSpace")
  ),
  el_checkbox(
    "cfg_plain",
    "plain",
    value = vue_bind("$store.cfg_button.plain")
  ),
  el_checkbox(
    "cfg_round",
    "round",
    value = vue_bind("$store.cfg_button.round")
  ),
  el_checkbox(
    "cfg_dashed",
    "dashed",
    value = vue_bind("$store.cfg_button.dashed")
  ),
  el_checkbox("cfg_text", "text", value = vue_bind("$store.cfg_button.text")),
  el_select(
    "cfg_type",
    choices = c("primary", "success", "warning", "danger", "info", "default"),
    selected = vue_bind("$store.cfg_button.type"),
    width = "150px"
  )
)
el_divider()
el_config_provider(
  id = "cfg",
  button = vue_bind("$store.cfg_button.config"),
  el_button("cfg_btn", "中文")
)
```

## Link Configurations

The selects set the provider's `link` settings through a store's getter,
which the link inside takes as its defaults.

```{r link, eval = FALSE, shot = TRUE, shot_js = c("document.querySelector('#cfg_type .el-select__wrapper').click()", "Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.el-select-dropdown__item')).find(function(o){ return o.innerText.trim() === 'danger'; }).click()"), shot_expect = "document.querySelector('#cfg .el-link--danger')"}
vue_store(
  "cfg_links",
  state = list(type = "success", underline = "always"),
  getters = list(config = JS("function(s) { return Object.assign({}, s); }"))
)
tags$div(
  style = "display: flex; gap: 16px",
  tags$div(
    style = "display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; flex-basis: 150px",
    tags$span("Type:"),
    el_select(
      "cfg_type",
      choices = c("primary", "success", "warning", "info", "danger", "default"),
      selected = vue_bind("$store.cfg_links.type")
    )
  ),
  tags$div(
    style = "display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; flex-basis: 150px",
    tags$span("Underline:"),
    el_select(
      "cfg_underline",
      choices = c("always", "never", "hover"),
      selected = vue_bind("$store.cfg_links.underline")
    )
  )
)
el_divider()
el_config_provider(
  id = "cfg",
  link = vue_bind("$store.cfg_links.config"),
  el_link("Link desu!", id = "cfg_link")
)
```

## Card Configurations

The radios set the provider's `card` settings through a store's getter;
a card inside takes them when it sets no `shadow` of its own.

```{r card, eval = FALSE, shot = TRUE, shot_js = "Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#cfg_shadow .el-radio')).find(function(r){ return r.innerText.trim() === 'never'; }).click()", shot_expect = "document.querySelector('.el-card.is-never-shadow')"}
vue_store(
  "cfg_card",
  state = list(shadow = "always"),
  getters = list(config = JS("function(s) { return { shadow: s.shadow }; }"))
)
tags$span("Shadow:")
el_radio_group(
  "cfg_shadow",
  choices = c("always", "hover", "never"),
  value = vue_bind("$store.cfg_card.shadow")
)
el_divider()
el_config_provider(
  id = "cfg",
  card = vue_bind("$store.cfg_card.config"),
  el_card("Card desu!")
)
```

## Dialog Configurations

The switches set the provider's `dialog` settings through a store's
getter, which the dialog inside takes as its defaults; `overflow` is off
while the dialog cannot be dragged. Element's `transition` setting is not
taken: the dialog is markup and plays Element's own `dialog-fade`.

```{r dialog, eval = FALSE, shot = TRUE, shot_js = c("document.querySelector('#cfg_align .el-switch').click()", "document.querySelector('#cfg_open button').click()"), shot_sel = ".el-overlay", shot_expect = c("document.querySelector('#cfg_dlg .el-dialog.is-align-center')", "document.querySelector('#cfg_dlg .el-dialog__body').innerText.indexOf('Dialog Content') >= 0")}
vue_store(
  "cfg_dialog",
  state = list(
    alignCenter = FALSE,
    draggable = FALSE,
    overflow = FALSE,
    open = FALSE
  ),
  getters = list(
    config = JS(
      "function(s) { return { alignCenter: s.alignCenter, draggable: s.draggable, overflow: s.overflow }; }"
    ),
    fixed = JS("function(s) { return !s.draggable; }")
  )
)
tags$div(
  style = "display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px",
  el_switch(
    "cfg_align",
    value = vue_bind("$store.cfg_dialog.alignCenter"),
    active_text = "alignCenter"
  ),
  tags$div(
    style = "display: flex; gap: 16px",
    el_switch(
      "cfg_drag",
      value = vue_bind("$store.cfg_dialog.draggable"),
      active_text = "draggable"
    ),
    el_switch(
      "cfg_overflow",
      value = vue_bind("$store.cfg_dialog.overflow"),
      active_text = "overflow",
      disabled = vue_bind("$store.cfg_dialog.fixed")
    )
  ),
  tags$div(
    el_button(
      "cfg_open",
      "Open Dialog",
      type = "primary",
      size = "small",
      on = list(click = "$store.cfg_dialog.open = true")
    )
  )
)
el_config_provider(
  id = "cfg",
  dialog = vue_bind("$store.cfg_dialog.config"),
  el_dialog(
    "cfg_dlg",
    title = "Dialog Title",
    destroy_on_close = TRUE,
    visible = vue_bind("$store.cfg_dialog.open"),
    content = "Dialog Content"
  )
)
```

## Message Configurations

The provider's `message` settings are Element Plus's page-wide message
defaults, so they reach every message on the page -- `$message()` in the
browser, `el_message()` from the server: at most three at a time, plain,
at the bottom.

```{r message, eval = FALSE, shot = TRUE, shot_js = "var b = document.querySelector('.el-button'); [0, 300, 600, 900].forEach(function(t) { setTimeout(function() { b.click(); }, t); });", shot_wait = 2, shot_expect = c("document.querySelectorAll('.el-message').length === 3", "document.querySelector('.el-message.is-plain')", "document.querySelector('.el-message').style.bottom")}
el_config_provider(
  message = list(max = 3, plain = TRUE, placement = "bottom"),
  el_button(
    "cfg_msg",
    "OPEN",
    on = list(click = "$message('This is a message from bottom.')")
  )
)
```

## Empty Values Configurations

<details>
  <summary>Supported components list</summary>

- Cascader
- ColorPicker 2.10.3
- DatePicker
- Select
- SelectV2
- TimePicker
- TimeSelect
- TreeSelect

</details>

Set `empty-values` to support empty values of components. The fallback value is `['', null, undefined]`. If you think the empty string is meaningful, write `[undefined, null]`.

Set `value-on-clear` to set the return value when cleared. The fallback value is `undefined`. In the date component is `null`. If you want to set `undefined`, use `() => undefined`.

```{r empty-values, eval = FALSE, shot = TRUE}
el_config_provider(
  value_on_clear = NULL,
  empty_values = list(NULL),
  el_select(
    "cfg_sel",
    choices = c("Option1", "Option2", "Option3"),
    clearable = TRUE,
    placeholder = "Select",
    width = "240px"
  )
)
```

## Table Configurations

The checkbox and the select set the provider's `table` settings through
a store's getter: a column that sets no `show_overflow_tooltip` of its
own takes them.

```{r table, eval = FALSE, shot = TRUE, shot_js = c("window.tip = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#cfg tbody tr:first-child .cell')).map(function(c) { return c.classList.contains('el-tooltip'); }).join()", "document.querySelector('#cfg_tip .el-checkbox').click()"), shot_expect = c("window.tip === 'false,true,true,true,false'", "document.querySelectorAll('#cfg tbody .cell.el-tooltip').length === 0")}
vue_store(
  "cfg_table",
  state = list(showOverflowTooltip = TRUE, tooltipEffect = "dark"),
  getters = list(config = JS("function(s) { return Object.assign({}, s); }"))
)
tags$div(
  el_checkbox(
    "cfg_tip",
    "showOverflowTooltip",
    value = vue_bind("$store.cfg_table.showOverflowTooltip")
  ),
  el_select(
    "cfg_effect",
    choices = c(dark = "dark", light = "light"),
    selected = vue_bind("$store.cfg_table.tooltipEffect"),
    width = "150px"
  )
)
el_divider()
el_config_provider(
  id = "cfg",
  table = vue_bind("$store.cfg_table.config"),
  el_table(
    data = data.frame(
      date = c("2016-05-03", "2016-05-02", "2016-05-04"),
      name = "Tom",
      address = "No. 189, Grove St, Los Angeles, a long address for the cell"
    ),
    selection = TRUE,
    columns = list(
      el_table_column("date", "Date", width = 120),
      el_table_column("name", "Name", width = 120),
      el_table_column(
        "address",
        "Address (inherited from config-provider)",
        width = 300
      ),
      el_table_column(
        "address",
        "Address (explicit false)",
        show_overflow_tooltip = FALSE
      )
    )
  )
)
```
